storyCampaign.title: The Signal Garden
storyCampaign.premise: SplatBot enters a living city-lab where paths, lights, sounds, and messages keep the community systems balanced. Each chapter unlocks a new station by solving a robot-control problem.

chapters.title: The Quiet Gate
chapters.story: The west gate has stopped answering its morning check-in. SplatBot must cross the entry path, touch the data pod, and send the first repair signal.
chapters.studentGoal: Reach a target, send a message, and return safely.

chapters.title: Breath of the Atrium
chapters.story: The garden's air valves are stuck in sleep mode. Each valve wakes only when SplatBot arrives in the right order and plays a clear tone.
chapters.studentGoal: Visit ordered checkpoints and use sound as feedback.

chapters.title: Bridge of Thin Lines
chapters.story: A narrow skybridge carries updates between two towers. SplatBot needs a careful route that never slips into the blocked service lanes.
chapters.studentGoal: Navigate a constrained path and report delivery.

chapters.title: The Matching Floor
chapters.story: The workshop floor has mixed its marker pairs. SplatBot restores the pattern by visiting matching tiles and lighting the signal at each correct pair.
chapters.studentGoal: Use loops and signals to model matching.

chapters.title: Cylinder of Weather Words
chapters.story: A small message cylinder holds a forecast clue for the garden roof. SplatBot must find it, decode it, and pass the word to the message log.
chapters.studentGoal: Combine navigation with a human-readable code clue.

chapters.title: The Turning Core
chapters.story: The central rhythm wheel has lost its beat. SplatBot rebuilds the pulse with turn patterns and a short song.
chapters.studentGoal: Create a timed rotation and music pattern.

chapters.title: Lantern Network
chapters.story: Four lantern stations can only restart if every team shares the same symbol sequence. SplatBot carries the pattern from browser to browser.
chapters.studentGoal: Share and verify a sequence using messages or QR codes.

chapters.title: The Color Lock
chapters.story: The final route opens only when the color order is correct. SplatBot follows the coded path and uses the signal light to show each solved step.
chapters.studentGoal: Decode a sequence, follow it, and show progress.

questChallenges.title: Data Pod Dock
questChallenges.tagline: Reach the pod, confirm the pickup, return with a signal.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Program SplatBot to follow a narrow route, touch a data pod zone, send a pickup message, and return to a base square.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Based on a retrieval-style robot challenge, remade as a screen-only navigation and confirmation mission.

questChallenges.title: Air Valve Burst
questChallenges.tagline: Trigger each valve without bumping the service wall.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Use movement, sensing, and sound blocks to visit five valve markers in order and play a tone at each one.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Models an extension-and-target task without requiring physical pipes or balls.

questChallenges.title: Skyline Carrier
questChallenges.tagline: Stay on the path, deliver the payload, report the drop.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Guide SplatBot along a one-cell-wide bridge, pause at a drop zone, send a delivery message, and leave without crossing blocked cells.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Inspired by cable-delivery constraints, translated into a virtual bridge and drop-zone route.

questChallenges.title: Bolt Bay Sort
questChallenges.tagline: Match the markers before the timer runs out.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Build a program that visits paired bolt markers, changes the signal light on matches, and uses loops for repeated pairs.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Recasts a nut-and-bolt manipulation challenge as matching, routing, and state feedback.

questChallenges.title: Message Cylinder Rescue
questChallenges.tagline: Find the cylinder, decode the clue, carry the answer forward.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Navigate to a cylinder marker, read a short clue from the mission prompt, and send the decoded word through the message log.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Keeps the idea of a hidden message container while moving the physical grabber into a virtual clue-and-message workflow.

questChallenges.title: Core Spin Sync
questChallenges.tagline: Hold the rhythm long enough to stabilize the grid.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Create a spin pattern using turn blocks and a short song, then keep the pattern running for the required number of beats.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Represents gear-and-top stabilization as timed rotation, loop design, and generated audio.

questChallenges.title: Symbol Link
questChallenges.tagline: Share the right sequence so every station agrees.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Use messages or QR share codes to pass a symbol sequence between teams, then program SplatBot to visit matching symbol tiles.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Adapts hub-display symbol coordination into open web sharing without special hardware.

questChallenges.title: Color Lock Path
questChallenges.tagline: Follow the colors, unlock the route, finish together.
questChallenges.virtualTask: Decode a color order from the mission prompt, visit color tiles in that order, and use the signal light to show progress.
questChallenges.teacherNote: Turns a color-display final challenge into a virtual tile path and signal-light protocol.

concepts.title: Decomposition
concepts.tagline: Split a big job into smaller jobs you can solve.

teks: Technology Applications: digital systems and collaboration
ngss: SEP: Planning and carrying out investigations

activities.title: Robot Route Chunks
activities.model: Break a long route into start, middle, and finish commands.
activities.prompt: Mark the turns first, then fill in the moves between them.

activities.title: Backpack Bot
activities.model: Sort a packing task into books, tools, lunch, and extras.
activities.prompt: Create one mini-program for each pocket.

activities.title: Obstacle Cleanup
activities.model: Separate a cluttered grid into safe spaces, blocked spaces, and target spaces.
activities.prompt: Solve one zone before moving to the next.

activities.title: Sound Show Parts
activities.model: Build a robot celebration from movement, light, message, and sound.
activities.prompt: Code each effect as its own small step.

activities.title: Mission Debug Pieces
activities.model: Divide a failed run into where it started, where it turned, and where it stopped.
activities.prompt: Fix only the first broken part.

activities.title: Classroom Delivery
activities.model: Break a delivery job into pickup, travel, drop-off, and return.
activities.prompt: Write one command group for each phase.

activities.title: Sensor Job Split
activities.model: Separate sensing from acting: check first, move second.
activities.prompt: Use an if block before the drive block.

activities.title: Map Maker
activities.model: Divide the field into rows, columns, walls, and goals.
activities.prompt: Describe each part before coding.

activities.title: Team Robot Roles
activities.model: Split a shared challenge into driver, checker, builder, and tester roles.
activities.prompt: Each teammate owns one part of the solution.

activities.title: Big Program Labels
activities.model: Name the parts of a program: setup, repeat, decision, finish.
activities.prompt: Add one improvement to each part.

concepts.title: Pattern Recognition
concepts.tagline: Notice what repeats, matches, or changes by a rule.

ngss: SEP: Using mathematics and computational thinking

activities.title: Repeat Road
activities.model: Find repeated move-turn pairs in a route.
activities.prompt: Replace repeated commands with a loop.

activities.title: Sensor Rhythm
activities.model: Spot when wall checks happen before every turn.
activities.prompt: Use the same if pattern at each corner.

activities.title: Grid Step Pattern
activities.model: Recognize routes that move the same number of spaces each time.
activities.prompt: Predict the next stop before running.

activities.title: Sound Beat Bot
activities.model: Use repeated beeps and pauses as a pattern.
activities.prompt: Make a sound pattern that matches a movement pattern.

activities.title: Color Path Rules
activities.model: Look for rows, columns, or corners that follow a rule.
activities.prompt: State the rule before coding.

activities.title: Bug Pattern Hunt
activities.model: Find the same mistake happening more than once.
activities.prompt: Fix the repeated cause, not just one symptom.

activities.title: Schedule Robot
activities.model: Model a daily routine as repeated events.
activities.prompt: Use loops for repeated classroom transitions.

activities.title: Dance Loop
activities.model: Find a movement phrase that repeats in a robot dance.
activities.prompt: Create a looped dance and change one beat.

activities.title: Message Sequence
activities.model: Spot patterns in status messages like ready, moving, done.
activities.prompt: Send messages at matching points in each run.

activities.title: Almost the Same
activities.model: Compare two programs and identify what changed.
activities.prompt: Circle the commands that stayed the same.

concepts.title: Abstraction
concepts.tagline: Keep the useful idea and leave out details that do not matter yet.

teks: Technology Applications: digital citizenship and communication
ngss: SEP: Obtaining, evaluating, and communicating information

activities.title: Simple Map
activities.model: Turn a busy classroom map into only start, walls, and goal.
activities.prompt: Remove decoration before planning the route.

activities.title: Robot Icon Plan
activities.model: Represent actions with simple icons: move, turn, sense, signal.
activities.prompt: Use icons to explain a program to a partner.

activities.title: Mission Summary
activities.model: Summarize a challenge in one sentence.
activities.prompt: Say what matters most before adding commands.

activities.title: Sensor Snapshot
activities.model: Reduce sensor data to clear states: wall, no wall, goal, not goal.
activities.prompt: Choose the state your code actually needs.

activities.title: Sound Meaning
activities.model: Use one beep to mean done and another to mean try again.
activities.prompt: Create a tiny signal language.

activities.title: Route Sketch
activities.model: Draw only corners and distances, not every grid square.
activities.prompt: Turn the sketch into commands.

activities.title: Rule Name
activities.model: Give a repeated chunk a useful name.
activities.prompt: Explain the named idea without listing every command.

activities.title: Noise Filter
activities.model: Ignore small random changes when using rough movement.
activities.prompt: Focus on reaching the zone, not the exact square first.

activities.title: One Big Idea
activities.model: Choose the most important idea in a messy program.
activities.prompt: Write a title for what the program does.

activities.title: Helpful Details
activities.model: Decide which details belong in teacher notes and which belong in code.
activities.prompt: Separate explanation from instructions.

concepts.title: Algorithm Development
concepts.tagline: Make clear steps that can be followed, tested, and improved.

ngss: SEP: Using mathematics and computational thinking

activities.title: Step-by-Step Route
activities.model: Write a route as ordered commands from start to goal.
activities.prompt: Run after each section and revise.

activities.title: If Wall Plan
activities.model: Create a rule for what to do when a wall is ahead.
activities.prompt: Test the rule in two different places.

activities.title: Loop Builder
activities.model: Turn repeated commands into a shorter algorithm.
activities.prompt: Compare the long version and loop version.

activities.title: Rescue Algorithm
activities.model: Plan how SplatBot should recover after a blocked move.
activities.prompt: Add a turn and try a new path.

activities.title: Signal at Finish
activities.model: Add finish steps: stop, light on, send message, play sound.
activities.prompt: Make the ending clear to an observer.

activities.title: Rough Movement Fix
activities.model: Improve an algorithm so it survives fuzzy movement.
activities.prompt: Use sensing after rough moves.

activities.title: Phone Tilt Control
activities.model: Use the controller as part of the algorithm.
activities.prompt: Add a condition for tilt or loud sound.

activities.title: Two-Version Test
activities.model: Create two algorithms for the same goal and compare them.
activities.prompt: Which is shorter? Which is easier to debug?

activities.title: Trace Revision
activities.model: Use a run trace to find the first command that caused trouble.
activities.prompt: Change one step and run again.

activities.title: Teach the Robot
activities.model: Record a ghost route, convert it to code, then improve it.
activities.prompt: Demonstrate first, edit second.
